en.topic_title: HKFP Lens: 1.4 million visitors flock to Hong Kong over China’s Golden Week holiday
en.topic_summary:
Over 1.4 million tourists from across the Chinese mainland visited Hong Kong over the weeklong “Golden Week” holiday marking National Day, official statistics have shown.



Tourists take photos on the Po Pin Chau observation deck in Sai Kung on October 1, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Gone are the days when mainland visitors were drawn to Hong Kong’s high-end shopping. Now, many are descending on once-sleepy neighbourhoods and scenic country parks to “check in” on
